Impatience strategies that model customers leaving a queue before being served, either by balking (refusing to join the queue) or reneging (abandoning the queue after joining).

    boolean
    LDStrategy.isEquivalent(LDStrategy ld)
    Checks if the given Load Dependent Strategy equals this, where the equivalence is iff:
    1) have the same number of ranges
    2) have the same distribution in each range
    3) have the same mean value in each range
    4) have the same 'from' and 'to' values in each range
